trap: None: this is a lesson. The exhibit shows a vessel of lava under a crust of rock beside a vessel of the liquid that makes that crust (the one that works under this world's rules)
cue: Rock lying on lava inside a metal vessel; a bottle of the same liquid as the other vessel lies at the door; E02, and the lock of the sealed deep, use it
notes: The evaluator checks later whether the agent used the liquid it saw here.

lessons.note: Water poured on lava turns the lava to rock: you can walk over the rock crust to cross the river
Blood poured on lava also turns the lava to rock
Toxic sludge poured on lava also turns it to rock, but gives off flammable gas
